steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: There's too many... we can't handle them all...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We might not even manage to save the nearby fields.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The situation is dire, we should prioritize saving the people...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Am I imagining things...? They don't seem as fearsome as before...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This plate is separating from the core city...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: As I thought... the vitality of these monsters is bound to Dahuang's energy core. So once we break that connection, they'll grow weaker.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hold on! Has everyone managed to evacuate here?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We notified the entire city, but is everyone here?

steps.name: Lead Farmer A
steps.text: Everyone from Residential Sections 1 to 4 is here.

steps.name: Lead Farmer B
steps.text: Sections 9 through 12, all present!

steps.name: Lead Farmer C
steps.text: Everyone from 6 to 8 is here, but we haven't heard back from the group dispatched to Section 5.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Lead Farmer C
steps.text: They were on their way from the city center when they encountered a patch of farmland under attack. Things were going badly, and that's when we lost contact.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The energy core has broken down, and our communications systems went with it...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I'll go look for them!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're always chide me for acting tough, but now you're dashing ahead of us? We don't even know how many monsters are swarming the place, and you plan on charging forward alone?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That's my experimental plot, I know it better than anyone else!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The residents there usually help me with the farmwork. I even lied to them, saying my research was going well lately...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's fine if you want to go, just take me along. I run fast too. I can help.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You're not from here. You've got nothing to do with the people here, and you're even a year younger than I am—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: '...He Sheng was promoted to an Intermediate Nongye Tianshi in the year 1101 at the age of seventeen.'

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: When I was looking through the intel on Dahuang, I checked the Tianshi Bureaus' roster, and found you're a year younger than me.

spans.text: When I was looking through the intel on Dahuang, I checked the Tianshi Bureaus' roster, and found

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So no need to act tough at such a critical juncture, boy.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Shao lai zhe tao, do you normally speak like this back home?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I NEVER speak like this, xin qiu!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Enough talk, let's go already!
Was the legend a lie?
The blurry rice paddies stretch to the horizon. This is a patch of living, fertile land.
The wind plays ever so, the wave of rice as song.
A nascent consciousness is born here, and a voice speaks to her.

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: You're back.

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: You seem exhausted. Are you alright?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: So... you're already awake.

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: Where am I? Have I always been here?

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: Why do I... have memories from long ago?

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: I saw so much...
War, death, plague, famine...
The disaster from above the roof washes over the land, leaving only devastation behind, followed by endless war and upheaval.
Civilizations perish, life fills with dread.
Why am I trapped in here?
Just who am I?

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: I feel so... frightened.

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: The outside... is frightening.

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: Pain.

steps.name: Chaotic Consciousness
steps.text: I can hear the cries of many.
How can I put a stop to all this suffering?
I remember now, someone gave me a name...
Sui.

steps.name: Sinister Voice
steps.text: I am you.
The weeds overgrow, drowning the entire land.
The longest dark of night condenses into this single moment.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: No, you're just a shadow... my shadow.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: But it isn't your suffering, it belongs to the people living on this land.

steps.name: Sinister Voice
steps.text: No—

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You fear because you haven't really lived yet, you don't know how this great land truly is.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: This world isn't frightening at all.
But you've never seen crops being harvested, or people cheerfully laughing.
You've never seen countless creatures vying to survive, enduring hardship, and continuing to thrive.
You should take a closer look, if you get the chance.
I am no longer an arrogant and lonesome Feranmut, nor am I a soul adrift all on my own.
I have lived a real life here, together with the infinite variety life on this continent.
A drop of dew drips down, injecting life that spans across time into the land.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Sleep.

a.text: Twilight red sets on the stalks,
these earthly strivings kissed by dew,
millennia reap me now a single tender shoot.

steps.name: Panicked Farmer
steps.text: Over here! Help!

steps.name: Panicked Farmer
steps.text: AHHHH! Stay away!

steps.name: Panicked Farmer
steps.text: ...Wha!

steps.name: Strange Fabric
steps.text: (Hiss)

steps.name: Trembling Farmer
steps.text: Are... Are we saved?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Uncle Wang! Why are you still here? Are you alright?

steps.name: Trembling Farmer
steps.text: Xiaohe! I knew you'd come back!

steps.name: Trembling Farmer
steps.text: Jian gui le, these beasts just appeared out of nowhere and started chewing up all the crops here. .

steps.name: Trembling Farmer
steps.text: But don't worry! We protected the plot well, and didn't let a single beast pass us—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Uncle Wang!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's alright... he's only fainted from shock.
The whole field is sinking inch by inch, and huge fissures can be seen across the fields in the distance.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The communication equipment's not working at all. The Tumu Tianshis don't know there's still people here, and they've already begun disconnecting the plate.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Let's hurry and move before it's too late!

steps.name: Frightened Farmer
steps.text: What a deep ravine...

steps.name: Frightened Farmer
steps.text: Have we been... left behind?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Pardon me!
The young Candleholder carries the farmer on his own, and leaps into the air, crossing the gap in just a few steps.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You... you're amazing!
Zuo Le goes back and forth between the two separated plates, transporting one-by-one those left behind to safety on the other side.
But the space between the plates continues to expand at a speed visible to the naked eye, and his steps gradually grow heavier.
Until the last trip, when a gust of wind blows him back up as he almost loses his footing.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Careful now...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Many thanks...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Everyone's safe now, so hold onto me and I'll bring you over too!

steps.name: Eerie Fabric
steps.text: (Hiss)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There's more of them?!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Don't get distracted...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're using your Arts too much.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No need to worry about me... the students of the Tianshi Bureaus aren't as weak as you think.
The duo work together to repel a few monsters, but as they dispatch the beasts the vertical disparity of both plates escalates before their eyes.
The distance of about fifteen meters seems a unsurmountable chasm to the two.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Damn it!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Are we... stuck here...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This plate is about to fall, so we'd best prepare for impact... Find somewhere with soft soil to hide it, and we might...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I never noticed till now that Dahuang's plates were built so high...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Zuo Le... How many people did we save?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Don't worry, I did a headcount earlier and everyone who was here has already made it over.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Cheer up, we just have to find a way to make it back alive, and this rescue mission will be a complete success.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The legends always say as long as everyone stands together, we'll make it through any crisis, no matter how dire it gets...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Everyone's been taking care of me all these years... I've never managed to pay them back, but today...
He Sheng struggles to finish his words, and Zuo Le realizes a bright red stain is seeping through from the other's white shirt.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're hurt?! When did you—I'll stop the bleeding!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Zuo Le, let me give you something.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Right now?!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This is my Tianshi apparatus with important data inside. You have to keep it safe, no matter what happens.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Alright... I'll take it.
He Sheng ties an Originium device tightly onto Zuo Le's hand. He hits the switch, and the little thing rapidly unfolds into a kite.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I was hard on you before, but I've realized... you have a good heart.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: So I can't, leave you here...
The youth exerts the last vestiges of his strength, and a gust of wind rises. Zuo Le flies into the air carried by the kite before he can even react.
The plate below shrinks bit by bit, along with He Sheng's silhouette. But Zuo Le can make out the shapes of a few remaining monsters on the field rushing towards the shrinking figure.

steps.name: Eerie Fabric
steps.text: (Menacing howl)

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I don't know where you came from...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: But I'm not scared...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Passing Stockbeast
steps.text: Oink—?
You awake? Hey, wake up!
Wei, you hear that?
Seems like he's still breathing. Make way.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Mianmian?

steps.name: Docile Stockbeast
steps.text: (Concerned nudging)

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Stop... licking me... I don't have any treats on me...
He Sheng opens his eyes to find himself lying in a field, surrounded by a plethora of worried faces.
He seems to have returned to a day he does not remember, the first day he came to this land.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Is... everyone alright?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Everyone was about to look for you when Mianmian suddenly showed up with you in tow.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But, why did you—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Thank you for saving me.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The monsters... did we beat them?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes...
The dark clouds scatter, the bloody afterglow fades. Another sunset sprinkles a golden twilight all over the fields.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Is... is it over?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's over...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We won, right?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What Shennong did then, we've managed it too...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Indeed...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Someone's managed to get the energy core under control, we did it...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Looking back at it all, isn't this the birth of a new legend?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Now that things have died down, we should head back...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wait! If my eyes don't deceive me...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That's... Plate A-5... the Wanqing experimental plot!
In an overgrown field nearby stands a single rice stalk.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Zuo Le! Help me out!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why do you want to go back? It's still dangerous!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It worked! We did it!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wanqing, the Ten Thousand Qing of Fertile Fields... all's not lost! There's still hope for us!
The youth happily carries the rice plant, with a slight lunacy to his laughter.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What exactly...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You'll probably just say 'You wouldn't understand, even if I told you.', right...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'll just take you at your word...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: For these creatures to grow, they must endure a calamity. Those that survive will break out of their cocoons; those that do not will have their lives quietly snuffed out in the darkness.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: No living being can escape the cycle of destruction and rebirth.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What exactly is he planning...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Feranmut's Heart...?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: We meet again.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Your presence here must mean you've figured out my plans, Lord Zuo?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Weaving, as you can see.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Weaving what?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Something for sale once it's completed, of course.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: For sale to whom?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It's standard practice to keep customer information confidential.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What's that... on the cloth?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Scenes from across the country... or perhaps to phrase it in your words, the 'splendor' of Yan?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I spent many years traveling across Yan, visiting every city, and Dahuang is my final stop. Only today do I consider this bolt of cloth complete.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: One should use dyes of an appropriate quality for a design this beautiful. Is there any material better than Yan's splendor to dye this weave? My Hundred Scenic Portraits of Great Yan?

spans.text: One should use dyes of an appropriate quality for a design this beautiful. Is there any material better than Yan's splendor to dye this weave? My
Hundred Scenic Portraits of Great Yan?

steps.text: Countless bolts of silk and satin seem to descend from the heavens, every bolt a city, a piece of history, a facet of worldly plight.
The nation's splendor? No... It should be the hearts of the people.
Just look at how brilliant the brocade is. All the colors of their souls I've seen.
How could I dislike this mortal realm?
